service.description: Calculate a draft sales invoice's tax lines through its store's tax gateway, else its organization's (PartyAcctgPreference.taxGatewayConfigId): one ItemSalesTax line under each taxed item for each authority, with the authority, rate version, base, rate and rounding. Lines the gateway calculated before are replaced, or kept when the results are the same. Answers a reason code without calculating for an invoice that is not a sales invoice (NOT_APPLICABLE), one billed from orders, whose tax came with the order (ORDER_TAX), and an organization and store with no gateway (NO_GATEWAY). Refuses with its reason a sale whose tax cannot be calculated (TAX_ADDRESS_MISSING, TAX_RATE_MISSING, TAX_RATE_AMBIGUOUS) and an invoice that is not a draft. With clear, only removes the calculated lines.

The local gateway: for each taxable item (a product line not marked non-taxable, a line marked taxable, a shipping line whose rate taxes shipping) and each authority whose geo is one of the destination's, where the organization or one it rolls up to has nexus (TaxAuthorityParty.isNexus) and a sales tax rate, the tax at the most specific TaxAuthorityRate in effect on the tax date (category, then store, then organization), rounded to the currency. A customer exempt in the authority (TaxAuthorityParty.isExempt) gets a zero result with its reason. An organization with no sales tax nexus gets no results. Refuses a taxed sale without a destination (TAX_ADDRESS_MISSING), an authority with no rate in effect (TAX_RATE_MISSING) and two rates of the same scope (TAX_RATE_AMBIGUOUS).

Explain what the organization's tax gateway (its store's, else its own) charges for a sample sale on a date: each authority's rate version, base, unrounded and rounded tax, rounding and exemption, or the reason it cannot be calculated (reasonCode and message). The destination is a geo, else the customer's address. Writes nothing. Refuses a user without Accounting read authority in the organization.

Create or change a tax authority, and the organization's links to it: its tax account (TaxAuthorityGlAccount, where the organization's tax lines of the authority post) and its nexus and registration (TaxAuthorityParty). An authority is shared by every organization, so changing an existing one's name, level, region, party or registration rules needs system administration; its changes are audit-logged. A nexus or registration change ends the organization's current TaxAuthorityParty row and starts a new one (an empty partyTaxId clears the number). Refuses a user without finance administration in the organization, a missing name, an unknown geo or authority party, an account not assigned to the organization, a shared change without system administration (AUTHORITY_SHARED) and a missing change reason.

return.message: AUTHORITY_NAME_REQUIRED: Give the authority a name
AUTHORITY_SHARED: The authority is shared; a system administrator changes it

set.from: {isNexus:isNexus || registration?.isNexus || 'N', partyTaxId:('partyTaxId' in context ? partyTaxId : registration?.partyTaxId) || null}

service.description: Start a dated tax rate of an authority for the organization, optionally for a store or product category. Given the rate it replaces (taxAuthorityRateId), the new version starts at fromDate and the old one ends there; given only that rate and a thruDate, it ends the rate. Earlier versions stay, so a tax line keeps the version it was calculated with. Refuses a user without finance administration in the organization, an unknown authority, store or category, a rate outside 0 to 100, an end not after the start, a version that does not start after the one it replaces, another rate of the same authority, type and scope over the same dates, a change to a rate for every organization without system administration (RATE_SHARED), and a missing change reason.

return.message: RATE_UNAVAILABLE: Tax rate is not available
RATE_SHARED: The rate is shared; a system administrator changes it
RATE_DATES_INVALID: A rate must end after it starts

set.from: {taxAuthorityId:taxAuthorityId, rateTypeEnumId:rateTypeEnumId || replaced?.rateTypeEnumId || 'TarSalesTax', organizationPartyId:organizationPartyId, productStoreId:(replaced ? replaced.productStoreId : productStoreId) || null, productCategoryId:(replaced ? replaced.productCategoryId : productCategoryId) || null, taxPercentage:taxPercentage, taxShipping:taxShipping || replaced?.taxShipping || 'N', minItemPrice:minItemPrice ?? replaced?.minItemPrice ?? null, minPurchase:minPurchase ?? replaced?.minPurchase ?? null, fromDate:fromDate || ec.user.nowTimestamp, thruDate:thruDate || null, description:description || replaced?.description || null}

return.message: RATE_INVALID: Enter a rate from 0 to 100 percent
RATE_DATES_INVALID: A rate must end after it starts
RATE_DATES_INVALID: A new version starts after the one it replaces

set.from: Array.from(authorityRates).filter(row => row.taxAuthorityRateId !== taxAuthorityRateId && (row.rateTypeEnumId || null) === rateFields.rateTypeEnumId && (row.organizationPartyId || null) === organizationPartyId && (row.productStoreId || null) === rateFields.productStoreId && (row.productCategoryId || null) === rateFields.productCategoryId && (row.thruDate == null || policy.ms(row.thruDate) > policy.ms(rateFields.fromDate)) && (rateFields.thruDate == null || policy.ms(row.fromDate) < policy.ms(rateFields.thruDate)))

return.message: RATE_OVERLAP: Another rate of this authority and scope covers these dates; replace or end it

service.description: The tax lines of an authority on the organization's issued sales invoices dated in a period, each with its invoice, customer, base, rate and tax, and their totals: those of a statement (taxStatementId), or of an organization, authority and period. Refuses a user without Accounting read authority in the organization.

A sales tax statement of an authority for one of the organization's periods, on the LocalSalesTaxReturn form: its taxable sales, tax and line count over find#SalesTaxLines. A later statement of the same period is a revision; the earlier one stays. Refuses a user without TAX_STATEMENT_EDIT in the organization, an unknown authority and a period that is not the organization's.

parameter.name: operationKey
parameter.description: A retry with the same key answers the first statement.

service.description: The 1099-MISC data of a year for each vendor registered with the authority and not exempt (TaxAuthorityParty) whom the organization paid at least the threshold in the period: amounts by box from the payments of the period applied to the vendor's invoices, through create#Vendor1099MiscStatement. Each vendor is its own step: one without a taxpayer number or payment address is named in failures with its reason and the run goes on; paid vendors under the threshold, not registered, or with a statement for the period already are in skipped, with the reason. Card and third-party network payments are left out (1099-K). Refuses a user without TAX_STATEMENT_EDIT in the organization and a period that is not the organization's.

A tax statement's data as CSV, with its format version, and who exported it and when: a sales tax statement's lines, refused when its invoices changed since it was made (STATEMENT_STALE); a 1099's form fields, refused without the recipient's taxpayer number or name. Other forms are refused (EXPORT_UNSUPPORTED). The data is not a filing in a form an authority prescribes. Refuses a user without TAX_STATEMENT_EDIT in the statement period's organization.

return.message: STATEMENT_EXPORTED: An exported statement is kept; create a new one to correct it
